gaps.sentence: Several roads were ___ by the flooding.
gaps.explanation: 'Wash out' = (of floods/rain) damage or destroy a road/bridge/event; 'washed up' = carried to shore.

gaps.sentence: The factory was ___ for safety violations.
gaps.hint: made to pay money as penalty
gaps.explanation: 'Be fined for something' = made to pay a penalty; 'charged' = formally accused.

gaps.sentence: His explanation didn't ___ at all believable.
gaps.explanation: 'Sound + adjective' = seem from what is said: doesn't sound believable.

gaps.sentence: The stadium holds ___ eighty thousand spectators.
gaps.explanation: 'Up to + number' = as many as (a maximum).

gaps.sentence: The new bridge ___ traffic congestion enormously.
gaps.explanation: The bridge is the agent: active present perfect — has reduced. 'Has been reduced' would mean someone reduced the bridge.

gaps.sentence: The committee ___ to delay the vote until May.
gaps.explanation: 'Agree to do' = consent; 'accept' takes an object (accept the plan), not to-infinitive.

gaps.sentence: The audio guide comes ___ twelve languages.
The match was ___ because of the storm.
gaps.explanation: call off = cancel; call up = phone/summon; call for = demand.
